subject: Split billing workflow for Aurelia pilot — entity routing & VAT declarations
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@aureliapharma.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@aureliapharma.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Request: split invoices + VAT routing for Q2 pilot (Aurelia)

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the pilot went well and procurement asked me to confirm invoicing details so they can process payment promptly. We need Redwood to issue split invoices for the Q2 pilot work (PO: PO-88741). Requirements below: 

- Two billed entities: 
  1) Aurelia Pharma (EU entity) — VAT should be handled via reverse-charge where applicable (we will supply the EU VAT ID).
  2) Aurelia Pharma Global (non-EU) — standard 0%/non-EU treatments as appropriate.
- Invoice lines must be routed to cost centers in the attached CSV (column: cost_center_code). Examples: R&D-41, PROD-87.
- Separate invoice numbers for each entity; we need PDFs for both entities sent to accounts-payable@aureliapharma.com and copied to procurement@aureliapharma.com.
- Payment terms: Net30.

I attached a CSV with the purchase order, line items, and cost center mapping (aurelia_split_request.csv). Can you confirm: 1) whether Redwood can emit two invoices from the same billing event, 2) how VAT reverse-charge will appear on the EU invoice, and 3) expected delivery date for the PDFs?

Appreciate a quick confirmation so I can clear this with our AP team.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager
Aurelia Pharma
(Attachment: aurelia_split_request.csv)
From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@aureliapharma.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@aureliapharma.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: split invoices + VAT routing for Q2 pilot (Aurelia)

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear notes and the CSV. Yes, we can do this; below is our proposed playbook and timeline.

Summary of approach (high level):
1) Single billing event -> generate two invoice documents: one per Aurelia entity. Each invoice will contain the same base line items but routed and tagged per entity/cost center as requested.
2) Tax handling: we will apply a VAT reverse-charge line item on the EU invoice (clear labeling: "VAT reverse charge — customer liable" with your EU VAT ID shown). The Global invoice will be tax-exempt/non-EU as applicable.
3) Cost center allocation: invoice lines will include a "cost_center" custom field in the invoice PDF and in the accounting metadata we send to your ledger (CSV/EDIFACT as you prefer).

Action items we need from Aurelia: 
- Confirm the EU VAT ID for Aurelia Pharma (EU entity).
- Confirm that procurement@aureliapharma.com should be CC'd on final PDFs (looks like yes from your note).

Internal timeline: 3 business days to produce sample PDFs (we'll run them past you for sign-off), + 1 business day after approval to issue final invoices. So target: sample by Thu, 2027-05-05 and final PDFs by Fri, 2027-05-07 assuming no changes.

I attached our split-invoice template (split_invoice_template_v1.xlsx) so you can verify layout.

Next steps: Im copying our billing ops team to build the sample and confirm routing rules.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: split_invoice_template_v1.xlsx)

Marcus / Ben / Priyom,

Forwarding Aurelia's request and our reply. TL;DR: they want two PDFs (EU entity + Global), VAT reverse-charge on the EU invoice, and per-line cost center codes per the attached CSV. Targets: sample by Thu 5/5, final by Fri 5/7.

Engineering/ops asks:
- Marcus: can we create a billing rule that emits two invoice artifacts from the same charge event? Prefer keeping them tied by "original_billing_id" so we can look up the unified event in alerts/logs.
- Ben: please generate sample invoice PDFs using the template Laura attached. Key requirements: cost_center must appear on each line, tax_label ("Reverse charge — Article X") must show on EU invoice, and each invoice must include the correct legal entity header (use the entity_name & tax_id fields). Also include metadata fields in the outbound accounting CSV: entity_id, cost_center_code, tax_code, invoice_number.
- Priyom: confirm whether the existing rounding policy (proportional cents split across lines) is acceptable to Aurelia or whether they expect line-by-line rounding.

Notes: we will use ledger routing tags: invoice.metadata.entity_id -> maps to the appropriate GL in our accounting connector. Keep an eye on the VAT engine: if EU VAT ID is present mark reverse_charge=true and set tax_code=RC_EU_20.

Ben — can you mock a sample and attach it back into this thread?

Thanks,
Laura
